overview: After breakfast you went up and did not open the tables at once. They lay shut on the bed. The stylus was in the gutter. You sat with the cover down.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Waited with the cover down, then wrote the three words and stopped.

assets.name: the writing-tables
assets.disposition: Wrote three words for the morning

important_dates.meaning: Went up and sat with the tables shut

summary: Wrote three words for the morning
